reasons: Only one setting in the file.

terms.meaning: A development-only check in React that runs some code twice to reveal hidden bugs.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Next.js settings
sections.what: Turns on strict mode, which makes React check for hidden bugs while the app is in development.
sections.why: Likely reason: to catch side-effect problems early.
sections.watch_out: Timers and startup loads can run twice in development, so test them in a production build too.

summary: The Next.js settings file, which currently only turns on strict mode.
purpose: Controls how Next.js builds and runs the app.
why: Likely reason: strict mode helps catch bugs during development.
how: 1) Sets strict mode on. 2) Exports the settings for Next.js to read.
inputs: Read by Next.js when it starts or builds.
outputs: Changes how the app runs in development.
risks: In development, strict mode runs some effects twice, so timers and data loads may look doubled while developing. Production is not affected.
debug: If an effect seems to run twice in development, this setting is the likely cause. Check the effect code for side effects that should not repeat.
